title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-13
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.2 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k)

ai_review.summary: Pristine soundboard capture of the Feb 13 1970 Fillmore show, highlighted by a soaring Dark Star → The Other One → Lovelight sequence and tight acoustic set.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a “pristine document” with crystal‑clear mix and excellent balance – DP4 quality that even seasoned archivists laud. Musically the night delivers a relaxed first set that builds into an electric marathon featuring Dark Star, The Other One, Lovelight and a monster Smokestack Lightning, earning unanimous acclaim from listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: All ten reviews give five‑star ratings and consistently praise both the performance (standout jams, tight playing) and the soundboard recording quality, leaving little doubt of an exceptional show.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear, balanced mix; reviewers call it “pristine” and “beyond compare,” noting only a slight brightness that some listeners tweak with EQ.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A relaxed acoustic set that segues into a high‑energy electric set; the band builds momentum with tight jams and seamless transitions, culminating in an iconic Dark Star → The Other One → Lovelight stretch.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his lead work on Dark Star and overall guitar brilliance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for a strutting bass riff and playing lead alongside Jerry; described as tight and perfect.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted as being at his best, receiving credit for strong rhythm/vocal contributions.
